title: Onboarding checklist
body: System setup order (also in Setup Hub /setup): (1) Companies UAE AED / Qatar QAR. (2) Currency AED/QAR. (3) Administration users/groups/sequences. (4) Party. (5) Product. (6) Inventory & Stock. (7) Calendar. (8) Financial — CoA/FY in SAO then draft invoice smoke. (9) Health — institution, patients, appointments, lab/pharmacy/beds. Also: sign in EN/AR, Help role/country filters, find IST-P-* patient, run wf-system-setup, read synthetic-data policy. Track checkboxes in the Help Centre onboarding panel.
